describe.description: A large quadrupedal animal is shown in right-facing profile standing on a plain light background, covered in dense long shaggy brown fur that is darker on the lower legs and lighter tan on the muzzle and mid-flank, with a bear-like head, four thick sturdy legs ending in clawed paws, a very short stubby tail at the rear, a single large glossy black curved horn projecting from the forehead, and a large domed glossy dark reddish-brown to black segmented exoskeleton covering the entire dorsal surface from behind the shoulders to the rump.

parts.looks_like: bear-like with a broad blunt snout, black nose, small brown eyes, light tan fur on the muzzle and lower cheek, and dense brown fur over the crown and jowls
parts.where: at the front of the body, facing right

parts.looks_like: one large glossy black horn with a smooth surface, curving up and forward from the forehead, with several sharp notches and points along its inner concave edge and a small secondary point at the base
parts.where: arising from the midline of the forehead between the ears

parts.looks_like: two small rounded furry ears covered in brown fur
parts.where: on top of the head, one on each side of the horn base

parts.looks_like: four thick columnar legs covered in long shaggy dark brown fur, muscular in appearance
parts.where: two forelegs under the chest and two hind legs under the hips, supporting the body

parts.looks_like: four broad paws with long curved light gray claws protruding from the fur, five claws visible on each front paw
parts.where: at the ends of the four legs on the ground

parts.looks_like: a very short small rounded nub covered in brown fur
parts.where: at the extreme rear of the body on the left side

parts.looks_like: a large domed glossy carapace dark reddish-brown to black, with a smooth shield-like anterior section over the shoulders and a transversely ridged posterior section, with a small yellowish patch visible at the neck junction
parts.where: covering the entire back from just behind the neck to above the tail base

parts.looks_like: about twelve overlapping hard transverse plates with pale sutures between them forming the posterior two-thirds of the shell, and a lower lateral row of small rectangular sub-plates each with two small oval holes
parts.where: across the dorsal surface and along the lower edge of the shell where it meets the fur

parts.looks_like: a horizontal row of seven small oval dark-rimmed openings with light centers, resembling spiracles
parts.where: on the furry flank just below the lower edge of the shell, running from mid-body to the hip

describe.description: A large four-legged mammal standing in profile facing right, with dense shaggy brown bear-like fur, a bear head with long muzzle, small rounded ears and short tail, and thick bear legs ending in clawed paws. Its entire back from behind the shoulders to the rump is covered by a glossy dark reddish-brown segmented beetle-like carapace with a larger shield over the shoulders, with a row of oval dark-rimmed holes like insect spiracles along the flank beneath the shell edge, and a single long curved glossy black beetle-like horn with teeth on its inner edge rising from the forehead.
